repair.title: The data in this browser is damaged
repair.intro: The database file on this device is damaged. This can happen when the phone closes the app in the middle of saving, for example while loading a large genome. Repair keeps everything that can still be read (people, health log, documents, settings), rebuilds DNA from the genome files kept on this device, and starts a clean database. Anything still missing comes back by loading your backup.
repair.done: Repaired: kept {people} people and {entries} health-log entries, and rebuilt the DNA of {genomes} people.
